sections.heading: 1. Loosen up and lift smart
lines: ① Roll your shoulders back 10 times.
② Bend your knees, hold boxes close.
③ Stretch calves and thighs every 1–2 hours.
④ Finish your shift with a warm shower.

caption:
Lulu hops on and off the scooter and lifts parcels all day. Lately her shoulders and back stay tight, even on days off.

Repeating the same movements for hours can leave muscles tired and tense. Short breaks, regular stretches and keeping boxes close to your body may help share the load. Remedial massage can be a helpful sidekick, easing tight muscles as part of your recovery.

Hybi's tip: roll your shoulders back 10 times between drops and stretch your calves and thighs every hour or two.

Numbness, pins and needles or pain that wakes you are worth getting checked. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD remedial massage therapists can help. Book online via the link in bio

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
